note: Manufacturer sources checked 2026-10-18. Shimano bike.shimano.com product pages are client-rendered; en-NZ locale used (en-NA shows the same content). Specs below are quoted from these pages/charts. No source here establishes pricing.

items.title: Shimano RD-R7000-SS spec page
items.claim: Low sprocket max 30T, min 25T; total capacity 35T; max front difference 16T; 11-speed; covers 11-25T to 11-30T.

items.title: Shimano RD-R7000-GS spec page
items.claim: Low sprocket max 34T, min 28T; total capacity 39T; max front difference 16T; 11-speed; covers 11-28T to 11-34T.

items.title: Shimano CS-R7000 spec page
items.claim: Offered in 11-28, 11-30, 11-32, 12-25 (no 11-34). HG spline L (road 12/11-speed), no spacer.

items.title: Shimano CS-HG800-11 spec page
items.claim: 11-34T (11-13-15-17-19-21-23-25-27-30-34); compatible with GS cage rear derailleurs; HG spline M; spacer required to fit road hub body.

items.title: Shimano compatibility chart C-731 (freehub splines)
items.claim: CS-HG800 / CS-HG700 / CS-RS400 of road 11-speed are compatible with HG spline L by installing a 1.85 mm spacer.

items.title: Shimano compatibility chart C-454 (road rear drivetrain 2x11)
items.claim: 2x11 row lists ST-R7000, RD-R7000-SS (25-30T), RD-R7000-GS (28-34T), cassettes CS-R7000 and CS-HG800-11, chains CN-HG601-11 among others.

items.title: Shimano compatibility chart C-254 (derailleur vs cassette, 11-speed)
Shimano compatibility chart C-455 (road front drivetrain 2x11)
Shimano ST-R7000 spec page
items.claim: 11 rear speeds; listed with both RD-R7000-SS and RD-R7000-GS in C-454.

items.title: Shimano CN-HG601-11 spec page
items.claim: HG 11-speed chain; listed in C-454 for the R7000 2x11 row.

items.title: Shimano dealer manual DM-RARD001-04 (rear derailleur R9100/R8000/R7000)
items.claim: Chain length: set on largest sprocket and largest chainring, then add links per manual (p.14). Length therefore changes with the largest cog. The manual does not require a new chain.

items.title: KMC X11 product page
items.claim: 11-speed; stated compatibility with Shimano, Campagnolo and SRAM 11-speed drivetrains. Not listed in Shimano charts (Shimano does not list third-party chains).

items.title: Shimano 2026-2027 Products Compatibility Information (PDF)
items.claim: Full compatibility chart set; source of C-254, C-454, C-455, C-731.
